items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Hazel Scott...an' all these people we worked with.

ctx.x: Was Pete Johnson still with you when you were doin' this?

Uh huh. The Drifters an' ssss..."Momma Treats Your Daughter Mean"...Fay Adams...an' all these people...Hazel Scott...an' all these people we worked with. It's practically all over the country we played.

An' I got through runnin' around with that...went back to Chicago, stayed the winter, then I headed back out in the summertime. In the meantime, in the wintertime, I play all up in Detroit, Michigan. Had a club up there called the Zombie Club. Had a club called Sportry's (?) Bar. I used to wrrk back an' forth between Sportry's (?) an' the Zombie Club. At Sportry's (?), they had a stage built up over the bar. You walked along a pathway up, uh...behind the bar, up high, up over the bar. Stood right on the stage,…
